RUNEPRIEST-CHALK_STYLUS.title: Chalk Stylus
RUNEPRIEST-CHALK_STYLUS.description: At the end of your turn, if your Incantation is empty, [gold]Inscribe[/gold] [blue]Ward[/blue] {Ward}.
RUNEPRIEST-CHALK_STYLUS.flavor: Worn to a nub by a thousand nervous doodles.
RUNEPRIEST-WHETSTONE_RUNE.title: Whetstone Rune
RUNEPRIEST-WARDING_CHARM.title: Warding Charm
RUNEPRIEST-WARDING_CHARM.description: At the start of each combat, [gold]Inscribe[/gold] [blue]Ward[/blue] {Ward}.
RUNEPRIEST-WARDING_CHARM.flavor: A circle drawn before the first blow.
RUNEPRIEST-BLOOD_CHALICE.title: Blood Chalice
RUNEPRIEST-INK_POT.title: Ink Pot
RUNEPRIEST-INK_POT.description: Whenever you [gold]Speak[/gold] {Glyphs} or more glyphs at once, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
RUNEPRIEST-INK_POT.flavor: Bottomless, if you don't look too closely.
RUNEPRIEST-OUROBOROS.title: Ouroboros
RUNEPRIEST-OUROBOROS.flavor: The end is the beginning is the end.
RUNEPRIEST-CURSED_QUILL.title: Cursed Quill
RUNEPRIEST-CURSED_QUILL.description: Your [blue]Strike[/blue] and [blue]Ward[/blue] runes gain {Bonus}. Upon pickup, add a [gold]Stray Glyph[/gold] to your deck.
RUNEPRIEST-CURSED_QUILL.flavor: It writes things you did not intend.
RUNEPRIEST-SLATE_TABLET.title: Slate Tablet
RUNEPRIEST-SLATE_TABLET.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. Your Incantation holds at most {Capacity} glyphs; extras [gold]Overflow[/gold].
RUNEPRIEST-TUNING_FORK.title: Tuning Fork
RUNEPRIEST-TUNING_FORK.description: At the start of each combat, gain {ResonancePower} [gold]Resonance[/gold].
RUNEPRIEST-TUNING_FORK.flavor: Hums in a key that isn't there.
